[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Fri 19:17): Linke ohne Emde | Gewalt an Kleistschule | Tabaksteuer
item.description:
Originally published Fri 16 Oct 2026 19:17 IDT.
In Berlin haben Linke, Grüne und SPD ihre Sondierungsgespräche fortgesetzt. Parallel dazu ist die Linke auf Abstand von der umstrittenen Abgeordneten Emke gegangen. Außerdem: Gewaltvorfälle an Kleistschule in FFO; Berliner Reaktionen auf Tabaksteuer; Blücherplatz in Eva-Mamlok-Platz umbenannt. "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Fri 17:54): Israeli settlers attack Palestinians during olive harvest
item.description:
Originally published Fri 16 Oct 2026 17:54 IDT.

The BBC has witnessed Israeli settlers attack Palestinians and set fire to olive trees in the occupied West Bank. Also: President Volodymyr Zelensky has said he is "only standing up for Ukraine's interests" after scathing criticism from Donald Trump. There has been a stark rise in anti-government activists deported to Russia from the EU and US, where they'd been seeking sanctuary. Researchers at the University of Maryland in the US have developed a tool to spot whether ideas are AI generated. A new version of Tesla's Roadster electric sports car, equipped with thrusters which apparently allow it to hover and turn in mid-air, has been unveiled in Texas. The number of ships that have reported being attacked in and around the Strait of Hormuz has hit a record high, BBC Verify analysis shows. A pioneering same-day test has been used to detect hidden and drug-resistant infections among children in intensive care. Experts are deciding whether to get rid of "leap seconds" altogether and replace them with a "leap hour" instead. And low-budget Spanish film La Bola Negra is emerging as a major Oscars contender.
